post_selection_policy: scene-post-01 through scene-post-05 are post-selection evaluation only and must be excluded from issue #8 training, validation, test authoring, contamination-driven editing, and issue #9 checkpoint or hyperparameter selection.

showcase_selection.eligible_pool: Post-selection outputs that meet the coherent-output gate, but only after the candidate suite meets every suite promotion gate.
showcase_selection.no_qualifier: Publish no showcase when the suite fails promotion or no post-selection output is coherent.

success_gates.coherent_output: At least 70% of its atomic facts retained (3 of 4 here), premise adherence yes, motive preservation yes, contradiction present no, loop/repetition present no, plot advancement yes, genre voice yes, and length compliant.
success_gates.uncertainty: Report exact numerator/denominator and two-sided 95% Wilson intervals for suite proportions. With only 40 outputs and 160 atomic-fact judgments, intervals are descriptive and genre strata are underpowered.

word_count.rule: Count case-insensitive ASCII letter/digit words with optional internal apostrophe using regex [a-z0-9]+(?:'[a-z]+)? over the decoded continuation only. The prompt and special tokens are excluded.
